crossRefs.note: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am Yahweh your God.
For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves…
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
“ ‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.
You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them…
The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as…
“ ‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Yahweh your God.
I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an…
I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings…
“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob…
I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt.…
I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.
Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: I am the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.
